content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Akron

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or global equivalent). You'll need to complete the required contact hours of project management education. Crucially, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM accessible to career-changers and early-career professionals in Akron's growing manufacturing and logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. This intensive format condenses foundational project management knowledge into a focused curriculum, delivered by experienced instructors who understand Northeast Ohio's project environments. Attend sessions on your schedule while gaining the PMI-recognized contact hours required for eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, apply directly to PMI through their official portal. Provide proof of your secondary degree and course completion documentation from Granite PM Academy. Pay the PMI exam fee to secure your testing authorization and move forward in the certification process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence in the CAPM body of knowledge. Schedule your exam at an authorized testing center. The computer-based exam assesses your grasp of project management fundamentals, processes, and best practices.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, stay current by earning professional development units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle. Engage in approved learning activities—courses, conferences, or volunteer project work—to demonstrate ongoing commitment to the profession. Renew before expiration to keep your credential active and competitive.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
